verdicts.title: On the structure of co-Kähler manifolds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: By the work of Li, a compact co-Kähler manifold $M$ is a mapping torus $K_\varphi$, where $K$ is a Kähler manifold and $\varphi$ is a Hermitian isometry. verdicts.title: Kähler metrics with constant weighted scalar curvature and weighted K-stability

verdicts.title: Okounkov bodies and the Kähler geometry of projective manifolds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given a projective manifold $X$ equipped with an ample line bundle $L$, we show how to embed certain torus-invariant domains $D \subseteq\mathbb{C}^n$ into $X$ so that the Euclidean Kähler form on $D$ extends to a Kähler form on X lying in the first Chern class of $L$.
